name: Exciting Games
source:
It has been four years since Steve and Nicole got married. They have everything, love, mutual understanding, prosperity. What else can one wish for happiness? But people always want more. They start looking for thrills and new impressions. However, in pursuit of new sensations they risk waking up the demons of lust sleeping inside them. Be careful what you wish for.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/guter_reiter]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
史蒂夫和妮可结婚已经四年了。他们拥有一切：爱、相互理解、繁荣。一个人还能祈求什么幸福呢？但人们总是想要更多。他们开始寻找刺激和新的印象。然而，为了追求新的感觉，他们冒着唤醒内心沉睡的欲望恶魔的风险。小心你的愿望。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/guter_reiter]Patreon[/url]]
